question: China is planning to launch its own 'artificial moon' in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chengdu**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In 2018, **it was reported that China is working on launching an artificial moon over the city of Chengdu, in the Sichuan province.**
 
• This project involves a satellite designed to reflect sunlight, potentially replacing streetlights and providing illumination to urban areas at night.
 
• The artificial moon is expected to be eight times brighter than the real moon and could light up an area of 10 to 80 kilometres in diameter.
 
• The artificial moon is essentially a **satellite equipped with a reflective coating** that can reflect sunlight onto specific areas of the Earth.
 
• The idea is to position the satellite to direct light to designated urban regions during nighttime, potentially replacing conventional streetlights.
 
• By providing additional nighttime illumination, the artificial moon could **reduce energy consumption** in urban areas by reducing the need for streetlights.
 
• The project claims that it could save an estimated **$170 million annually** in electricity costs for Chengdu alone.
